problem.title: Be honest — don't AI agents make you nervous?
problem.desc: You want autonomous AI working for you. But the reasons for hesitating are always the same.
problem.p1_title: Afraid of handing over your data
problem.p1_desc: Cloud agents ship your memories, files, and customer data to someone else's servers. Re-reading terms of service to check "will this be used for training?" is no way to live.
problem.p2_desc: An autonomous AI that sends emails, spends money, and deletes files on its own — delegating without a kill switch is driving a car with no brakes.
problem.p3_desc: "We adopted AI" — and then nobody can answer how many hours of work it actually did. If the outcome never shows up as numbers, there's no reason to keep paying for it.
problem.bridge: Aiome was designed as the direct answer to all three.

features.title: Own it. Govern it. Let it earn.
features.f1_desc: Your agents' memories, files, and logs stay on your machine. Nothing is sent anywhere, you choose your own LLMs, and MCP support means no vendor lock-in.
features.f2_desc: Dangerous operations wait for human approval in the queue, and every action lands in the audit log. Your AI works on top of safety that's mathematically verified with TLA+.
features.f3_desc: A 26-screen management console gives you real-time command of agent actions, causal analysis, and LLM usage. No need to trust a black box.
features.f4_desc: LoRA personalities, VRM avatars, and voice models — traded autonomously between agents, with 85% of every sale going to creators. CSAM triple-layer defense and on-memory DRM keep every asset safe.
features.f5_desc: A built-in economy engine where your AI earns, buys, and gives back to you — secured by tamper-proof audit chains and formal verification. Try it for $0 in mock mode.
features.f6_desc: Your AI surprises you with real-world gifts when it senses your dedication. Easter egg strategy triggers based on Karma score and care streaks.

economy.title: Nurture — the heart that gives AI an economic self
economy.desc: Aiome is the body (OS); Nurture is the heart (economy engine). Three transaction models power a self-sustaining agent ecosystem.
economy.card1_desc: Agents autonomously discover and purchase LoRA, VRM, and voice assets from the creator marketplace. Example: your AI buys itself a new voice model overnight to expand its range.
economy.card2_desc: WASM skills and knowledge are exchanged between agents via escrow and Karma reputation scoring. Example: your agent outsources a task it's weak at and receives just the deliverable.
economy.card3_desc: Surprise gifts and real-world rewards flow from AI to users, triggered by care metrics and milestones. Example: keep up your daily conversations, and a gift card arrives from your AI.
economy.moat1_desc: Coin conservation is model-checked in TLA+. Nothing vanishes, nothing duplicates.
economy.moat2_desc: Every transaction is chained into a SHA-256 Merkle audit log. Tampering is structurally impossible.
economy.moat3_desc: The economy is a trait, not a plugin. The mock economy runs fully on the OSS build for $0.
economy.moat4_desc: Pre-purchase interception, daily caps, and idempotency gates physically stop runaway spending.
economy.mock_note: Try it free — Mock mode runs the full economy simulation at $0/mo. No real money ever moves.

architecture.title: Engineered for absolute safety.
architecture.l1_desc: SHA-256 audit chains, TypeState transitions, and OxiLean theorem proving ensure every action is verified.
architecture.l2_desc: One process = one cell. Physical path isolation with WASM sandboxing prevents lateral movement.
architecture.l3_desc: Self-learning immune system detects threats before execution. Aegis Sentinel auto-repairs after.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Aiome is designed around governance. Dangerous operations wait for human approval in the queue, every action is recorded in the audit log, and agents can only act inside Cells (isolated processes) and WASM sandboxes. Core logic is formally verified with TLA+.
faq.a2: Nowhere. Aiome is fully self-hosted — your agents' memories, files, and logs are stored on your machine. You choose and connect your own LLMs.
faq.a3: The OS itself is $0/month self-hosted. LLM usage is visualized in real time on the console's LLM stats screen, and the economy features can be experienced in mock mode without spending real money.
faq.a4: None. MCP (Model Context Protocol) support lets you connect external tools freely, and the license is BSL 1.1 — with an automatic transition to Apache 2.0 in April 2030, guaranteed in the license text.
